scope: Manipal & Udupi, Karnataka Cultural Tourism Platform

typography.rules: Headings use Playfair Display with tight tracking. Body uses Plus Jakarta Sans for extreme legibility and warm human editorial feel.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle warm paper grain background #FDFBF7 with 1px earthy borders
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded-xl to rounded-2xl for organic warmth

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA compliant warm earthy contrast, high visibility text
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and informational elements

image_urls.description: Traditional Yakshagana performer in elaborate costume and headgear

universal_guidelines: Never use pure black #000000; use deep warm charcoal #2C221E
Every interactive element must have data-testid
No generic XP/level-up gamification; use personal scrapbook and badge showcase feeling
Custodian consent framework with 6 active toggles clearly exposed
